hypothesis: The basic QNN cosine-task advantage may be entirely due to its fixed feature family. Test an exact classical representation, not only a generic NN trained on raw features.
derivation: Z1 expectation = cos(theta1)*cos(x0)*cos(x1) - sin(theta1)*sin(x1). theta0 has no effect. Classical logit A*cos(x0)*cos(x1)+B*sin(x1)+bias reproduces any fitted basic QNN.
design: Verify identity for every saved basic-QNN fit on independent points; train3-parameter convex feature control on identical splits across all4 tasks and3 sample sizes.
fairness: Architecture-derived features, no additional labels. This is a diagnostic control and does not show all larger QNNs can be emulated efficiently.
